description: This file is a TypeScript source code implementing a script that interacts with GitHub API and OpenAI API to classify issues and pull requests, and automatically label them based on their content and classification results.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine script options such as limit, dryRun, and model.

methods.name: logHeader
methods.description: Logs a header title with underline.

methods.name: logStep
methods.description: Logs a step message.

methods.name: logSuccess
methods.description: Logs a success message.

methods.name: logInfo
methods.description: Logs an informational message.

methods.name: createEmptyState
methods.description: Creates an initial empty script state with empty issue and pull request sets.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads script state from a JSON file, or creates a new state if file does not exist.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves the current script state to a JSON file.

methods.name: buildStateSnapshot
methods.description: Builds a snapshot of the current state from issue and pull request sets.

methods.name: runGh
methods.description: Executes a GitHub CLI command and returns the output.

methods.name: resolveRepo
methods.description: Resolves the GitHub repository owner and name from git remote URL.

methods.name: fetchIssuePage
methods.description: Fetches a page of issues from GitHub GraphQL API.

methods.name: fetchPullRequestPage
methods.description: Fetches a page of pull requests from GitHub GraphQL API.

methods.name: mapNodeToLabelItem
methods.description: Converts a GitHub node to a LabelItem object.

methods.name: fetchOpenLabelItemBatches
methods.description: Generator that fetches batches of open issues or pull requests.

methods.name: fetchOpenIssueBatches
methods.description: Generator that fetches batches of open issues.

methods.name: fetchOpenPullRequestBatches
methods.description: Generator that fetches batches of open pull requests.

methods.name: truncateBody
methods.description: Truncates a body string to a maximum length for prompt inclusion.

methods.name: buildItemPrompt
methods.description: Builds a prompt string for classification based on issue or pull request.

methods.name: extractResponseText
methods.description: Extracts text content from OpenAI API response.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a record object.

methods.name: fallbackCategory
methods.description: Determines fallback category ('bug' or 'enhancement') based on issue text.

methods.name: normalizeClassification
methods.description: Normalizes raw classification data into a Classification object.

methods.name: classifyItem
methods.description: Classifies an issue or pull request using OpenAI API.

methods.name: applyLabels
methods.description: Applies labels to an issue or pull request via GitHub CLI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function orchestrating the classification and labeling process.
